overview: A Famennian total-group lamprey known from one 4.2 cm body fossil with a preserved oral disc and branchial basket.

ecology.diet: Undetermined; the oral disc does not by itself demonstrate parasitism
ecology.habitat: Waterloo Farm depositional setting; life habitat was not directly observed
ecology.locomotion: Elongate aquatic swimmer; performance was not measured

evidenceSummary: Holotype AM5750 directly records lamprey-grade anatomy, but it neither sets a crown-lamprey first appearance nor preserves lifecycle or feeding behaviour.

overview: A Moscovian cyclostome represented by a holotype and paratype whose revised anatomy combines general cyclostome and hagfish specializations.

ecology.habitat: Francis Creek Shale depositional setting; life habitat unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Elongate aquatic swimmer; performance not measured

evidenceSummary: FMNH PF15373 and PF8472 support a stem or putative total-group hagfish interpretation, while preservation leaves several structures equivocal and excludes the fossils from the crown-Myxini range.

overview: A complete Cenomanian hagfish body fossil recovered within crown Myxini in a morphology-based phylogenetic analysis.

ecology.locomotion: Elongate aquatic swimmer; performance not measured
ecology.bodySize: Complete body fossil; size follows the figured holotype

evidenceSummary: BHI 6445 supplies a crown-hagfish fossil bound and anatomical character set, but one specimen does not establish a global FAD, ecology or uninterrupted range.
